load_pretrained_audioseal: load a pretrained AudioSeal watermarking model using AudioSeal.get_pretrained with name and device parameters
apply_watermark_to_audio: apply audio watermarking to a tensor using AudioSeal forward method with alpha tune-down ratio
detect_watermark_in_audio: detect watermarks in an audio signal using AudioSeal detect_watermark method and return detection results
extract_watermark_from_audio: extract a watermark from an audio tensor using AudioSeal get_watermark method with optional message
create_custom_watermark_model: create a custom watermark model by subclassing WMModel and implementing get_watermark and detect_watermark
